gloss: feeling of hunger; sensation of an empty stomach

definitions.gloss: feeling of hunger; sensation of an empty stomach
definitions.explanation: The subjective physical sensation of being hungry. More clinical or objective than simply saying 'hungry,' focusing on the bodily feeling itself.

examples.japanese: {空腹感|くうふくかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{空腹感|くうふくかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{和|やわ}らぐ→和らぐ：07896_yawaragu⟧。
examples.english: Drinking water eases the feeling of hunger a little.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{空腹感|くうふくかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧しまうこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When stress builds up, you sometimes eat even without feeling hungry.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{空腹|くうふく}→空腹：06532_kuufuku⟧ (empty stomach, hunger) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling, sensation). Treats hunger as a measurable physical sensation rather than a simple state.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空腹感|くうふくかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel hunger
- {空腹感|くうふくかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紛|まぎ}らわす→紛らわす：08206_magirawasu⟧: to distract oneself from hunger
- {空腹感|くうふくかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{和|やわ}らぐ→和らぐ：07896_yawaragu⟧: hunger subsides
- {空腹感|くうふくかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to suppress hunger

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{空腹|くうふく}→空腹：06532_kuufuku⟧: hunger, empty stomach — the state itself rather than the sensation
- ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すく→すく：00756_suku⟧: to get hungry — the most common everyday expression
- ⟦{飢|う}え→飢え：19826_ue⟧: starvation, hunger — much stronger; implies severe deprivation
- ⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧: appetite — the desire to eat; can exist without actual hunger

USAGE:
Commonly used in health, diet, and medical contexts. Often appears in discussions about managing appetite, fasting, or distinguishing between genuine hunger and emotional eating.
